patch_description: Split the single shared RZ parameter into separate pre- and post-entanglement phases. Currently all RZ gates use "rz_shared", which means the same phase is applied before and after the CZ chain. By splitting into "rz_pre" (before CZ) and "rz_post" (after CZ), we enable finer interference control and potentially better generalization. This increases parameters from 2 to 3 (ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post) while maintaining maximal parameter sharing across blocks. The extra parameter provides an additional degree of freedom for phase tuning without significantly increasing circuit depth or gate count, addressing the recommendation for split phase control around the CZ sandwich.
